answer: Proposed pollinator-alert gate: each ID reserves a sensor beacon with a certified nonexportable key for a day, reporting pesticide plume risk near nectar crops. Validators check fresh ID-bound signatures and allow one ID per device/day; failed checks delist that ID. Devices are reusable capital; power recurs; no stake. Honest certification is assumed; readings can still be false and spare devices make entry cheap. Shared hosts and parallel calls cannot reuse reservations: ten concurrent IDs require ten beacons.
